name: RecessedAperture
description: An invented context layer for agents, where the hero is an aperture cut into the page
intent: A hole rather than a panel. The hero is an aperture cut through the surface with the content behind it, which inverts the usual arrangement where a hero sits on top of the page.

source.title: Recessed Aperture Hero Page
source.author: Ray Velez
